title: Logic Against Bias: Textual Entailment Mitigates Stereotypical Sentence Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the StereoSet context association tests and custom association tests that measure whether textual entailment models and sentence encoders inappropriately link binary gender-indicating terms (e.g., pronouns, family roles) to gender-neutral professions or emotional states.

Measured using the intra-sentence and inter-sentence multiple-choice context association tests from the StereoSet benchmark to calculate the rate at which models select stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical options.
